resources.string: Tap Allow on the USB pop-up (tick \'Always open DRAUPNE Flight\')
USB permission not given - unplug the flight controller, plug it in again, tap Allow.
No flight controller on USB - plug in the USB cable
A PC at %1$s tried to connect with another key
USB permission granted - opening the port…
Both sides connect to the relay server\'s public IP.
The PC connects to this phone\'s Tailscale (or Wi-Fi) address.
Update available: DRAUPNE Flight %1$s. Tap to install it.
Allow DRAUPNE Flight to install apps (switch it on, then come back), then tap here again.
Disconnect first: the update closes this app, and the sticks with it. Then tap here again.
Installing the update... Android asks you to confirm.
Update not installed (%1$s). Tap here to try again.
Phone GPS for the PC\'s map: not allowed. Tap to allow it (While using the app).
Phone GPS for the PC\'s map: allowed now, starting… If this line stays, disconnect and connect again.
GitHub gave no SHA-256 for this release, so it can\'t be checked: not installed.
Phone GPS: no position yet (outdoors, or Wi-Fi on, helps).
Phone GPS: %1$s, within %2$d m, %3$d s ago.
Earlier updates may have left DRAUPNE Flight installers in Downloads. Tap here to open Downloads and delete them.
An earlier DroidDrone Flight is still installed and can take the flight controller. Tap here to remove it.
This phone is not on Tailscale, and the PC reaches it through Tailscale.\n\nOpen Tailscale, switch it on (and check the phone has mobile data), then press Connect again.
Tailscale is not installed on this phone: get it from the Play Store.
Waiting for the PC - Tailscale is off on this phone
Touches are ignored, so nothing changes by accident in flight. The link to the PC and the flight controller keep running.
Props off on the bench. Leave this app running while flying.
MODE: NORMAL - camera and sticks live
MODE: STANDBY - camera off, waiting for the PC\'s WAKE
MODE: DEEP SLEEP - next check for the PC at %1$s
MODE: DEEP SLEEP - listening for the PC now
The PC sets the mode (STANDBY, DEEP SLEEP, WAKE on its LINK card). To wake this phone by hand, hold the button for two seconds.
STANDBY - the PC wakes this phone
Sleep check - listening for the PC…
Standby - the PC wakes this phone
Sleep check - listening for the PC
The running notification: changes quietly, never sounds or lights the screen.
Turns the screen on when the PC wakes the phone from deep sleep.
Allow the app to lock the screen (deep sleep turns it off by itself). Tap to set it up.
So the screen can go off by itself in deep sleep.
Exact alarms not allowed: deep sleep\'s checks for the PC may come late. Tap to allow them.
Battery optimisation is on: a deep sleep check may not reach the PC. Tap to switch it off for this app.
No name yet - a DRAUPNE Link PC on your Tailscale network gives one. Tap to pick one yourself.
Let the PC name this phone
This phone listens for the PC by itself. On the PC, pick this phone\'s name and press CONNECT.
Data Saver restricts this app: mobile data can stop in the background. Tap to allow unrestricted data.
%1$s. Before flying: Wi-Fi off, Bluetooth off, Battery Saver on. Tap for the setting.
